title: draconicX Remake
features:
MAIN TAB

ESP (Billboard)

· ESP Nextbots - displays name & distance of monsters/NPCs above their heads 
· ESP Players - displays info on other players (name, distance, health)
· ESP Tickets - highlights fallen tickets on the map

Highlight

· Highlight Players - creates colored outlines around other players (uses external module)
· Highlight Bots - outlines for nextbots/enemies

Tracer ESP

· Tracer Players - lines from bottom of screen to other player positions
· Tracer Bots - red lines toward nextbots

Respawn (Auto Self Revive)

Two modes:

· Spawnpoint - auto revives to spawn point
· Fake Revive - revives while saving last position, returns to that spot after death

Respawn Button - on-screen button (red-black gradient with spinning animation) for manual revive

Other Features

· Anti AFK - simulates mouse movement to prevent being kicked
· Auto Whistle - spams whistle every second
· No Camera Shake - removes screen shake effects
· Fly - noclip-style flight with adjustable speed (space up, shift down)
· Noclip - walk through walls
· Bug Emote - forces sit state continuously
· Remove Barriers - disables collision on invisible barriers
· Barriers Visible - makes invisible barriers visible (transparency = 0)
· Unlock Leaderboard/Zoom/Front View - custom UI buttons for leaderboard, zoom, and camera view

AUTO FARM TAB

Farming

· Auto Farm Money - automatically farms money (includes auto-revive module)
· Auto Farm Tickets - automatically collects tickets on the map
· AFK Farm - teleports to a security part and stays there (auto-win farm)

Teleports

· Custom Server - teleports to a specific server ID
· Teleport to Objective - randomly teleports to any objective on the map
· Teleport to Spawn - teleports to a random spawn point

COMBAT TAB

Anti-Nextbot

Detects when nextbots get too close and teleports you away. Three teleport modes:

· Players - teleports to a random player
· Spawn - teleports to a random spawn point
· Distance - teleports a set distance away (uses pathfinding to avoid obstacles)

Auto-farm features temporarily disable when nextbots are near, then re-enable when safe.

MISC TAB

Player Adjustments

· Player Speed - modifies movement speed (config tables found in memory)
· Player Jump Power - changes jump height
· Player Jump Cap - how many times you can jump
· Player Strafe Acceleration - air control value
· Apply Method - "Not Optimized" vs "Optimized" for applying changes
· Player FOV - changes camera field of view

Bounce

· Modify Bounce - changes walk speed in the Game/Players folder structure

Revive Players (Instant Revive)

· Automatically revives downed players within range
· Revive While Emoting - still revives even while doing an emote
· Revive Delay - adjustable cooldown (0-1 second)
· Button GUI - on-screen toggle button
· Keybind - default "R" to toggle

Carry Players

· Auto Carry - automatically carries nearby players (within 20 studs)
· Button GUI - on-screen button
· Keybind - default "F3"

Emote Speed

Three modes:

· Nah - normal speed
· Legit - modifies emote module speeds directly
· Multiplier speed - applies speed multiplier when emote state is detected
· Apply to Unwalkable Emotes - forces speed on emotes that normally lock you in place

Gun Functions (Tool Modifications)

· Grapplehook - increases speed, lifetime, removes gravity, removes cooldown, infinite ammo
· Breacher (Portal Gun) - infinite charges, max range, instant cooldown, removes ADS requirement
